hook: New Year · seven days unlimited · the annual re-up
job: Convert January trial demand and re-up the Jan-2026 annuals (8 annuals, ₹12.5L due). Nothing launches this month, so January sells the habit: a credited first week, a free comeback class and a re-up at list — and every January membership carries into February.
moment: January is the first week — a credited seven-day intro, a free comeback class and the annual re-up at list. Nothing launches early: every January membership carries into February, and the 30-day challenge picks it up from there.

offers.name: The First Seven Days
offers.tagline: Seven days unlimited. Then decide.

You pay: Intro: ₹2k for the 7-day unlimited intro, credited in full against a qualifying purchase within 72 hours. Then any pack or membership at 15% off list (the standing new-client perk).
You get: • Unlimited Barre and powerCycle for 7 days (max 2 classes a day)
• Goal-setting chat after class 1; owner check-in on day 3
• Lab Induction seat at Kwality/Bandra
• Buy any pack or membership within 72 hours of day 7: full intro fee credited + the standing 15%
• Buy in January and you're pre-registered for February's challenge (target scaled)
Rules: • One intro per person
• Credit only within 72 hours of day 7
• The 15% is the standing new-client perk, not an extra discount.
• Doesn't combine with any other campaign offer.
Effective discount: 15.0% effective = 15% cash. Guest passes, consults, freezes and early booking are valued at zero.
Expected revenue: ₹4.1L counted (+₹55.7k vs the ₹3.6L stream plan) · 18 buyers
Rate of sale: Needs ≈18 renewal purchases (plan 14).
Why it works: January leads are the most motivated of the year. Clients with 5+ visits in month one convert at 94%; a credited week lets the habit form before the ask, and a January purchase hands February a warm list.
What to watch: Intro → purchase (24% measured — plan at that rate); classes in the intro week (target 4+).
Offer auditor: 22/25 (Effect 5, Creativity 4, Clarity 5, Practical 4, Economics 4). Strongest January entry: bold, clear credit rule, and it hands February a warm list.
Model: 59 in pool × 23.7% plan rate × 1.25 conversion factor = 17.5 buyers × ₹26.7k ticket = ₹4.7L modelled; 50% of uplift counted

fields.Job: Answer "will it work for me?" (Bandra test)

alternatives.why: Bandra has the lowest new-client conversion (17–26%). A guarantee answers the core objection; 12 classes almost always produce improvement, so it rarely pays out. Watch: Guarantee claims; conversion vs other Bandra journeys. Auditor: Bold; run as a test before scaling.
